svg.title: Analysis workbench layout
svg.text: Archetype 3 — the analysis workbench (file already on disk)
Raven Pro [A2,A6,A10] · Audacity [A15,A17] · iZotope RX [A38,A39] · Sonic Visualiser [A25,A29] · Praat [A41]
time → the whole recording, drawn from the moment the file opens
The magnitude grid survives the drawing in all six: “the underlying power values have not changed so all
measurement values will be the same” [A10]. Gain and range re-map colour without re-running the FFT [A21, A31].
Not a requirement, only a habit: the whole file visible at once. Raven had to add paged windows for files
“too large to fit in the memory available” [A13]; RX ships a cache cap and “Reduce Quality Above” [A38].
